title: Cuentos populares en Chile
author: Ramón A. Laval
note: Cuentos populares en Chile (Laval, 1923), folk tales collected from Chilean storytellers: part I, 40 tales (one, El lión y el hombre, transcribed in country speech and resumed after a footnote under its heading repeated, is one item, labeled so), and part II, 43 myths, legends and stories of witches and the devil. Each starts at its numbered title; part II's 'Otra versión' items take the title of the item before. Dropped: footnote markers and the dialect footnote, section names and other lines in capitals, the collector's notes in parentheses stay. Ends at the appendix (bibliography and comparative notes).
